name: Extract Order ID
description: Extract one or more order IDs from an inbound customer service message. Order IDs are system-generated in the format ORD- followed by exactly 5 decimal digits.
sample_inputs: Hi, I need help with my order ORD-48291. It hasn't shipped yet.
Can you check orders ORD-10034 and ORD-10035? Both are late.
order ORD-99999 was supposed to arrive yesterday
My order number is ORD-00001 and the tracking hasn't updated.
I placed order ORD-73812 on Monday but got no confirmation email.

name: Parse Billing Amount
description: Extract the dollar amount referenced in a customer email or chat message when disputing a charge or asking about a fee. Amount is always US dollars, typically formatted as $XX.XX but may appear as $X or $XXX.
sample_inputs: I was charged $49.99 last Tuesday and I did not authorize this.
The invoice shows $120 but my contract says $99.00.
Why was I billed $7.50 for a service I cancelled?
There's a mysterious charge of $0.99 on my statement.
I expected to pay $250 not $312.75 — please explain the difference.

name: Determine Customer Sentiment
description: Classify the overall emotional tone of a customer complaint message: positive, neutral, frustrated, angry, or distressed. Used to prioritize escalation queue.
sample_inputs: I've been waiting THREE WEEKS and no one has helped me. This is absolutely unacceptable.
Hey, quick question — when does my renewal kick in? No rush.
I'm really disappointed. I trusted your service and it let me down.
Fine, whatever, just cancel it. I don't have the energy to deal with this anymore.
Your support team was great last time, but this issue has me a bit worried.

name: Extract Customer Name from Intro
description: Extract the full name a customer provides when identifying themselves at the start of a support conversation. Phrasing varies: 'My name is X', 'This is X', 'I'm X', 'It's X here', or the name may appear without any introductory phrase.
sample_inputs: My name is Sarah Johnson and I'm having trouble logging in.
Hi, this is Marcus Rivera. I'd like to update my billing address.
I'm Priya Nair. My account number is ACC-4481923.
Hey — it's Tom. Tom Bruckner. I placed an order last week.
4421983 — that's my account. The name is Dana Cho.

name: Parse Date Range from Natural Language
description: Extract a start date and end date from a customer message describing a time period. Dates are expressed in natural language and may be relative ('last month', 'next Tuesday') or anchored ('March 5th') with partial context.
sample_inputs: I need a statement for between March 5th and 10th last month.
Can you pull my activity from last Tuesday through this Friday?
Show me everything from the beginning of Q2 to yesterday.
I want records from 2 weeks ago until now.
Transactions between January 1st and the end of February please.

name: Extract Account Status from CRM JSON
description: Extract the 'account_status' field value from a Salesforce CRM API JSON response. The response is machine-generated and always follows the same schema. Possible values: active, suspended, pending_cancellation, closed.
sample_inputs: {"account_id": "ACC-1029384", "account_status": "active", "plan": "pro", "created_at": "2023-04-12T08:00:00Z"}
{"account_id": "ACC-9988771", "account_status": "suspended", "plan": "basic", "created_at": "2022-11-01T14:30:00Z", "suspended_reason": "non_payment"}
{"account_id": "ACC-0034521", "account_status": "pending_cancellation", "plan": "enterprise", "cancellation_date": "2026-06-15T00:00:00Z"}
{"account_id": "ACC-5512309", "account_status": "closed", "plan": "basic", "closed_at": "2025-12-01T00:00:00Z"}
{"account_id": "ACC-7743001", "account_status": "active", "plan": "pro", "trial_ends": "2026-07-01T00:00:00Z"}

name: Extract Mentioned Products
description: Identify all products the customer references in a complaint or inquiry. Products may be cited by their internal code (PROD-XX000), their marketing name, a colloquial nickname, or a misspelling. The product catalog has ~80 items.
sample_inputs: The PROD-PR001 plan doesn't include the analytics dashboard I was promised.
I bought the Pro subscription and the mobile app but neither are working.
Your basic tier is fine but I need the enterprise features for my team.
The PROD-EN010 enterprise package and the PROD-AD005 add-on are both broken.
I signed up for 'ProMax' or whatever it's called — the one above Pro.

name: Parse and Normalize Phone Number
description: Extract a phone number from a customer message and normalize it to E.164 format (+1XXXXXXXXXX for US numbers). Customers enter numbers in multiple formats: parenthesized area code, dashes only, dots, spaces, or international prefix.
sample_inputs: Call me back at (555) 123-4567 when you get a chance.
My number is 555-123-4567. Thanks.
+1 555 123 4567 — please use this going forward.
you can reach me at 5551234567 any time after 3pm
